author: Ash

copy.intro: Your favorite BKE jeans are gone in your waist, or the nearest Buckle is a long drive away. So you want its mix of denim brands somewhere else. These are the stores and denim labels people name as Buckle alternatives. Mall chains that stock several brands come first, then denim labels and department stores. Prices are for women's jeans unless a pick says otherwise, next to Buckle's own $54.99 to $308.

bodies.pacsun:
PacSun is the closest store to Buckle in how it's built: a mall chain selling its own label next to other brands, with baggy jeans at the center of it. It started as a surf shop in Seal Beach, California, so its denim sits next to surf and streetwear rather than Miss Me and Rock Revival.

The shipping rule is the useful part. Any US order with jeans or pants in it ships free, whatever the total, and everything else ships free over $59. Buckle's free shipping over $99 is a perk for premier members with its credit card, so one pair of jeans costs less to send from PacSun.

It ships within the US only. If you mostly buy Buckle's women's brands, maurices carries two of them.
bodies.maurices:
maurices is the pick if you shop Buckle's women's side, because it stocks two of the same jean brands, KanCan and Flying Monkey. Its own label starts low, with the m jeans by maurices Classic Mid Rise Flare Jeans ($34.90).

Sizes are the other reason to go. It sells women's clothing from 0 to 24, and its Silver Jeans Co. range adds Curvy and Petite cuts, up to the Suki Curvy Mid Rise Embellished Slim Boot Jeans ($108). US orders over $50 ship free, and it ships to Canada too.

Returns have no deadline with a receipt or order number, though a mailed return loses $6.95 from the refund. It's a women's store, so for men's jeans go to American Eagle or Levi's.
bodies.american-eagle:
American Eagle is the safe bet if what you buy at Buckle is mostly jeans. It's a jeans-first chain for men and women. The fit to know is Curvy, since several women's cuts come in a Curvy version, like the AE Curvy Super High-Waisted Baggy Wide-Leg Jean.

Returns get 60 days, the same window Buckle gives, and US orders ship free over $75. That's a lower bar than Buckle's card-member offer.

The trade-off is variety. It sells one brand's fits, so you won't find Miss Me or Rock Revival on the rack. If the mix of labels is why you shop Buckle, PacSun or maurices are the closer stores.
bodies.forever-21:
Forever 21 is the budget route to trend-led jeans, with regular-price pairs at $38 to $44, under anything Buckle sells at full price. Start with the Low Rise Bootcut Denim With Wide Buckle Detail ($44), and yes, the name fits the brief.

Expect a thin jeans range, though. Most of its denim is skirts and shorts, and it's online only now, shipping to all 50 states with free shipping over $50. Sizes run XS to XXL, with a Plus section.

Returns get 30 days but cost $9.99 to send back, and clearance can't be returned at all. If you want more jean cuts at a low price, Old Navy has far more of them.
bodies.lucky-brand:
Lucky Brand is where to go for premium denim from one label. It was founded in 1990 and it's rooted in denim and Americana. Its women's cut names are worth learning: Sweet Boot and Sweet Straight cover the boot and straight legs, and Lil Maggie Flare is the flare.

Waists run 24 to 35 with inseams from 27 to 34, and an Extended Sizes shop covers 33 to 35 and 2XL. That's narrower than maurices or Old Navy, so check your size before you fall for a wash. US orders ship free over $85, and it has its own US stores.

It sells only its own brand. If you want Lucky next to other labels, Nordstrom Rack stocks it alongside Levi's and Joe's.
bodies.levis:
Levi's is the obvious move if the jeans you buy at Buckle are already Levi's. Buckle stocks them, the Cinch Baggy Wide Leg Jean ($84.95) among them, but Levi's own stores carry the whole line under one roof.

It's been making jeans since 1853, starting in San Francisco, and its US stores are spread across 40 states. So you can try several cuts back to back in person, and that's the easiest way to find a Levi's fit you'll buy again.

It's one brand, men's and women's. If you want Levi's on the same rack as other labels, Dillard's and Nordstrom Rack both carry it.
bodies.gap:
Gap is the pick for plain jeans in a lot of lengths, from $79.95 to $99.95. The Curvy High Rise Stride Wide-Leg Ankle ($79.95) sits at the bottom of that range.

Women's jeans come in 000 to 20, with petite and tall runs and short, regular and long inseams. So it's the one to try if standard inseams never sit right on you, whatever cut you're after. Joining its free rewards program gets free shipping over $50, and returns get 30 days.

The price band is narrow, with nothing near Buckle's premium end. If you'd rather spend less on basics from the same company, Old Navy starts at $34.99.
bodies.aeropostale:
Aeropostale aims at the same teen and young-adult shopper Buckle does. Its women's jeans come at one flat price, $64.95, or $69.95 for embellished styles with rhinestone hearts, denim stars or lace flowers.

Most of the range is low-rise and super low-rise, in baggy, wide-leg, straight and bootcut shapes. So it's the cheaper route to the low-slung look Buckle sells as the BKE Taylor Low Slung Baggy Wide Leg ($79.99). Sizes go from 000 to 20 with short and long lengths, and shipping is free over $25, a low bar for a single pair.

It's one brand in one price band, so there's no premium denim here. For that, Dillard's carries 7 For All Mankind, as Buckle does.
bodies.old-navy:
Old Navy is the cheapest way into a lot of jean shapes, with regular prices from $34.99 to $69.99. The Curvy Mid-Rise Wow Bootcut ($34.99) is the low end, and the Old Navy x Altuzarra High-Waisted Baggy Wide-Leg ($69.99) is the top.

Sizes are the strong point. Jeans run 00 to 30, plus petite and tall, with short, regular and long inseams, so it's one of the few picks here that runs past a 28. US orders ship free over $50, and returns get 30 days.

The catch is the brand mix: everything is Old Navy's own. If you'd pay more for a plainer, narrower range from the same company, Gap is the step up.
bodies.nordstrom:
Nordstrom is the department-store version of Buckle's brand mix, only much bigger. Women's jeans run from the Roaman's Comfort Stretch Wide Leg Jean ($20) to Burberry Mid-rise Straight Jeans ($835). So it covers both ends of Buckle's range and goes far past the top.

Two policies make it easy to try things. US shipping is free with no minimum, and returns have no time limit, in store or by mail. Sizes go from 00 to 28W, with petite and plus.

The catch is size. With a listing that big, filter by brand and fit before you scroll. Nordstrom Rack is the off-price option if you want similar brands for less.
bodies.dillards:
Dillard's is the department store for Buckle's premium denim brands. It stocks Levi's, Good American and 7 For All Mankind, all of which Buckle sells too, and its women's jeans run from $36 to $350.

It has 272 stores in 30 states, 28 of them clearance centers, so trying a pair on in person is often an option. Sizes cover 00 to 16 and 1X to 3X, with petite and plus fits. Returns get 30 days.

The catch is shipping. It's free only on orders of $150 and up, and $9.95 below that, so one pair of jeans usually pays it. It suits a bigger order or a store visit better than a single online buy.
bodies.superdry:
Superdry is the pick for organic cotton jeans at Buckle's mid prices. Most of its full-price women's jeans carry an Organic Cotton name, and the Mid Rise Baggy Jeans ($74.95) open a range that tops out at $109.95.

It's a British label founded in 2003, selling to the US through a dollar-priced US store. Waists run 24 to 34, narrower than maurices or Old Navy, so it's for standard sizes. The organic skinny and wide-leg styles sit at the top price, so the cheapest pair isn't always the organic one.

It sells only its own brand. Treat it as one more label to add, not a Buckle-style mix.
bodies.abercrombie-fitch:
Abercrombie & Fitch is the men's pick if you shop Buckle for men's denim. Its men's jeans run from $80 for the Relaxed Straight and 90s Straight to $110 for the Relaxed Workwear Jean, with Baggy and Ultra Baggy at $90.

Waists go from 26 to 38, and the Baggy Workwear Pant ($100) gives you the same workwear look without the denim. It ships to the US and Canada, free over $99, the same total Buckle asks of its card members.

It sells women's jeans too, in wide leg, bootcut and straight cuts, but it's one brand. For a men's store with several labels on the shelf, PacSun is closer to Buckle.
bodies.nordstrom-rack:
Nordstrom Rack is where to find premium denim brands for less, with women's jeans from $39.97 to $79.97. The Levi's 501 '90s High Waist Straight Leg ($49.97) is a good place to start.

It's an off-price store, so each tile shows a comparable value next to its own price. The brands include Levi's, Good American, Lucky Brand and Joe's, and Buckle sells the first two as well. Sizes run 00 to 28W, with petite and plus. Free shipping starts at $89, and returns get 40 days.

The range is a fraction of Nordstrom's, so if you need one exact cut in your size, the full-price store has more to choose from.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: Start with what you buy at Buckle. If it's the brand mix, PacSun is the same kind of mall store, and maurices covers the women's side with KanCan and Flying Monkey. If it's Levi's, go straight to a Levi's store. For premium denim like 7 For All Mankind, Dillard's carries it at full price, while Nordstrom Rack has premium labels under $80. On a tight budget, Old Navy and Forever 21 both stay under $70. If fit is the problem, Gap covers petite and tall with three inseams, and maurices goes up to a size 24. Shopping for men's jeans? Start with Abercrombie & Fitch and PacSun.

faqs.q: What kind of store is Buckle?
faqs.a: Buckle is a denim-led mall chain with 440 stores in 42 states. It sells its own BKE and Buckle Black labels next to brands like Levi's, Miss Me and Rock Revival, and denim makes up over 40% of its sales.
faqs.source_query: what kind of store is buckle

faqs.q: What store is similar to Buckle?
faqs.a: PacSun is the closest match: a mall chain selling its own label next to other brands, with jeans at the center. For women's denim, maurices stocks two of Buckle's jean brands, KanCan and Flying Monkey.

faqs.q: Is Buckle a high end store?
faqs.a: It's mid-priced with a premium top end. Regular-price women's jeans run from $54.99 to $308, with its own BKE jeans near the low end and 7 For All Mankind at the top.

faqs.q: Can you return Buckle online orders in store?
faqs.a: Yes. Buckle lists free in-store returns within 60 days for what it sells online, while sending a return back by mail costs $6.99.
